about: Measured values of the free supplementary material of a paywalled article (the article itself was not opened), in the format of thermoml_<id>.json (read by measured_components.ThermoML). Extracted with pdftotext from the text layer of the supplement's PDF, Table S1, right-hand columns (alpha-angelica lactone; the left-hand columns are triacetin), PDF pages 1-12: 285 values at 0.5 K steps, 298.6-440.6 K, as printed. Pressure 0.1 MPa (the caption). The footnote (PDF page 19) gives standard uncertainties u(T) = 0.1 K and u(p) = 100 kPa (as printed) and a relative combined expanded uncertainty Ur(Cp) = 0.03 at the 0.95 level of confidence, used here as each value's uncertainty. Sample: the supplier's certificate in the supplement, purity (GC) 99.1 %.

source.citation: E. D. Nikitin, A. P. Popov, N. S. Bogatishcheva, M. Z. Faizullin, Experimental critical temperatures, pressures, heat capacities, and thermal diffusivities of triacetin and alpha-angelica lactone, Fluid Phase Equilib. 561 (2022) 113523
source.access: The article is paywalled; its supplementary information, which holds the measured heat capacities, is free to read on the publisher's site (Elsevier); no open licence stated
source.tables: Supplementary Table S1, heat capacity of liquid alpha-angelica lactone, 298.6-440.6 K (285 values); uncertainty footnote, PDF page 19

10.1016/j.fluid.2022.113523.title: Experimental critical temperatures, pressures, heat capacities, and thermal diffusivities of triacetin and alpha-angelica lactone
